purpose: Read-only matched local-label failure attribution; no feature or switch selected from realized quarters.
formula: Join the two native Qlib Recorder objects by identical trade_date; on mature local labels compute next-session adjusted SOXX 09:47 open / current-session adjusted SOXX 09:47 open - 1. Group only for attribution, never for a decision rule.
interpretation: The binding intervention is nearly a one-session extra 0.10 SOXX exposure, so realized next-session SOXX direction mechanically dominates its local fee-net difference. The 2022Q2 loss is a cash-deployment market-direction loss, not evidence of an ex-ante tradable quarter switch. Quarter averages and correlations are in-sample descriptions. Historical first-receipt qualification and a frozen predictive information gate are still required for a new receiver.
